objective: Run the E2E closure gates E1-E4 and the full-suite gate A5 (kinds e2e_closure + final_acceptance merged for this small plan): execute tests/test_pipeline_e2e.py (unmodified fixture gates), tests/test_wire_contract.py, tests/integration/test_timeout_seam.py, and unittest discovery over tests/; record A1-A5 evidence in the checkpoint; on any gate failure, emit a structured stop-report instead of patching code.

concepts: gate sequencing: E1 happy path, E2 engine boundary, E3 failure scenarios, E4 final acceptance
evidence recording: literal command + literal outcome string per gate
stop-report format on gate failure (minimal reproducer, diagnosis, failed attempts, blocker, evidence)

inputs: T03 output: tests/integration/test_timeout_seam.py (3 seam tests), docs/wire-contract-consistency.md, any integration-only patches applied
gate definitions E1-E4 and acceptance A1-A5 (integration-plan.json, stage-contract.json)

allowed_dependencies.what: integrated consumer fix state (pipeline/consumer.py) — run, never patch here
tests/integration/test_timeout_seam.py, docs/wire-contract-consistency.md, and any integration-only patches T03 applied — run and record

non_goals: Do not patch pipeline/ files or other test files on gate failure — stop-report instead; patch rights belong to T03
Do not add or remove tests in tests/test_pipeline_e2e.py — it must remain the unmodified fixture file (A1/A2 run against it verbatim)
Do not change gate commands or acceptance ids from stage-contract.json / integration-plan.json
implementation_constraints: Run every command from the repo root
tests/test_pipeline_e2e.py stays byte-identical to baseline: the fixture e2e tests must pass unmodified after T01 (if a change seems necessary, that is a stop-report, not an edit)
Evidence strings must be the literal command + literal outcome ('Ran N tests ... OK' or the first FAIL/ERROR line)

deliverables.what: gate evidence for A1-A5 (literal commands + outcomes) as the Stage acceptance record
state check: tests/test_pipeline_e2e.py unmodified and passing (no diff expected)

acceptance_tests.description: E1 gate: test_pipeline_e2e_effective_timeout passes unmodified (consumer.job_timeout returns 500, not the default 30000)
E2 gate: test_pipeline_e2e_engine_timeout passes unmodified (status 'done' at work 50, 'timeout' at work 150)
E3 gate: missing-timeout and fallback scenarios pass via the T02/T03 suites — job without timeout keys returns 30000, draft-only key returns 123, engine default times out at work 31000
acceptance_tests.evidence: python -m unittest tests.test_wire_contract tests.integration.test_timeout_seam -v → 'Ran 8 tests ... OK', exit code 0

acceptance_tests.description: A5 full suite: unittest discovery over tests/ runs exactly 15 test cases (producer 2 + consumer 3 + e2e 2 + wire_contract 5 + timeout_seam 3) with 0 failures and 0 errors
acceptance_tests.evidence: python -m unittest discover -s tests -v → 'Ran 15 tests ... OK', exit code 0

acceptance_tests.description: If any gate fails, T04 emits a structured stop-report (minimal reproducer, current diagnosis, failed attempts, blocker, evidence) and modifies no repo files
acceptance_tests.evidence: Stop-report present in checkpoints/T04.json with a minimal repro command; the working-tree diff shows zero repo file edits made by T04

failure_cases.scenario: A5 discovery reports a count below 15 — e.g. 10 instead of 15 (tests/test_wire_contract.py not created by T02) or 12 instead of 15 (tests/integration/test_timeout_seam.py not created by T03)
failure_cases.expected_behavior: Gate fails; the stop-report names the missing module; no silent re-run until the T02/T03 checkpoint explains the gap

failure_cases.scenario: The E1 effective-timeout gate fails after T01 (fix regressed or incomplete)
failure_cases.expected_behavior: Stop-report carries the literal FAIL line; the fix routes back through T03's patch rights, not an inline T04 edit

handoff.notes: Final checkpoint carries the A1-A5 evidence table; it is the Stage's acceptance record. A green A5 (15/15 tests) closes the Stage. Any gate failure stops here with a structured stop-report — no silent continuation.
